headline: Why China is giving away its best AI models
summary: China's Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 challenges US AI models with superior performance and lower cost. Silicon Valley is on high alert due to this new, competitive Chinese AI model. This move intensifies the global rivalry in artificial intelligence development.

headline: YouTube Premium will include Peacock starting next year
summary: YouTube Premium subscribers will gain access to Peacock's ad-supported content starting in 2027. This multi-year agreement allows streaming Peacock shows, movies, and live sports directly via YouTube. The bundle comes as YouTube's standard Premium subscription recently increased to $15.99/month.

headline: Amazon’s trying to launch a global satellite cellphone network in 2028
summary: Amazon filed an FCC application to deploy a new LEO satellite constellation by 2028. This network aims to provide direct-to-device services for voice, messaging, data, and emergencies globally. Amazon plans to partner with mobile operators to deliver this ambitious satellite service.

headline: This is my new favorite laptop, but thanks to RAMageddon it already went up in price by $800
summary: Framework laptops, known for their DIY premise and modularity, are facing significant price increases. Despite their unique upgradeability and repairability, a new 'Pro' model's price surged by $800. This increase challenges the value proposition, even for a reviewer's favorite laptop.

headline: Save up to 57% on Select Physical PS5 Games at Target in New Summer Sale
summary: Target launched a new summer sale offering significant discounts on physical PS5 games. Gamers can save up to 57% on titles like Saros, Stellar Blade, and Death Stranding 2. This sale provides excellent deals for PlayStation 5 owners looking to expand their game library.

headline: The Samsung Odyssey G5 27" QHD 180Hz OLED Gaming Monitor Drops to $299.99 on Amazon
summary: The Samsung Odyssey G5 27" QHD 180Hz OLED gaming monitor is now available for an unprecedented price of $299.99 on Amazon. This deal marks it as potentially the least expensive OLED gaming monitor ever. Gamers can seize this opportunity for high-quality visuals at a budget-friendly cost.

headline: Benedict Cumberbatch Joins Marvel Stars Calling on UK Government to Block 'Dangerous' Paramount-Warner Bros Merger Before It Causes a Disastrous 'TV and Cinema Calamity'
summary: Benedict Cumberbatch and other Marvel stars urge the UK government to block the Paramount-Warner Bros merger. They warn the proposed $110 billion buyout could lead to a 'TV and cinema calamity.' Concerns are rising over potential negative impacts on the entertainment industry.

headline: Exclusive First Look at Stormlight: War for Roshar, the Massive Brandon Sanderson Board Game
summary: Brotherwise Games is launching a new campaign for 'Stormlight: War for Roshar,' a massive board game. Fans of Brandon Sanderson's Stormlight Archive can get an exclusive first look at this highly anticipated offering. The game promises an immersive experience for enthusiasts of the fantasy series.

headline: Devastating European wildfires in maps - and how they're being tackled
summary: Massive wildfires are devastating parts of Europe, with a blaze near Bordeaux scorching over 162 sq miles. The Madrid region is experiencing its worst fires ever, highlighting the widespread crisis. Emergency services are battling these intense blazes, with maps showing the vast scale of destruction.

headline: Funeral director who left people unburied breached families' trust 'on industrial scale', court hears
summary: A funeral director is accused of breaching families' trust on an 'industrial scale' by leaving bodies unburied. Court hears the funeral parlour was likened to a 'horror scene' due to the neglect. The case reveals shocking details of profound disrespect and distress caused to grieving families.

headline: UK's iconic Jodrell Bank telescope faces axe in science cuts
summary: The UK's renowned Jodrell Bank telescope is under threat of closure due to proposed science budget cuts. Astronomers warn that axing the iconic facility would severely damage UK science. This move could also leave a generation of aspiring scientists untrained, impacting future research.

headline: Man jailed for abduction and rape of girl, 15, in Edinburgh basement
summary: Aaron Strachan has been jailed for the abduction and rape of a 15-year-old girl in an Edinburgh basement. He was told he may never be released from prison due to the severity of his crimes. The court handed down a harsh sentence for the horrific incident that occurred last year.
